name: bluerise-workforce
description: BlueRise Workforce — a modular workforce platform for employers and the people they employ.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @bluerise/api && npm run build --workspace @bluerise/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @bluerise/shared-config && npm run build --workspace @bluerise/shared-types
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @bluerise/api" "npm run dev --workspace @bluerise/web"
scripts.verify: npm run build:packages && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
